tagline: Guess the pro's six-item build. A new puzzle every day.
brief: A daily Wordle-style puzzle for Dota players, played on the web and inside Discord: guess the six items a pro finished a big tournament match with. It should feel like an esports broadcast — sharp, competitive, a daily ritual you share with your server — without borrowing Valve's artwork.
criteria: Success: ownable outside the sword-and-shield gaming clichés, reads at Discord avatar size, ties to the name, and comes from the game itself.

concepts.name: Build D
concepts.idea: Six item tiles assemble into a D: the build is the brand.
rationale: Six tiles = the six inventory slots every answer fills
Gold for Dota's currency, green for the slot you got right
A D on a 3×3 grid: square, bold, survives a Discord avatar
Wordmark in the game's own display face, converted to outlines

recommendation: Build D is the final mark: ownable, tied to the name, and drawn from the game's own mechanic.
